text:
Tree-cover loss was detected on the property in 2023, but the evidence does not establish whether the forest was cleared or the land use changed.

About **0.7 hectares**, or **1.2% of the 58.1-hectare property**, was mapped as tree-cover loss. The affected area was classified as forest in the 2020 reference map. The 2021 national map classified 0.4 hectares of it as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest.

The loss could reflect plantation harvesting or another cause, such as fire or storm damage. The evidence does not identify the cause.
